reason: The physically separate Patch file contains only most-recent patch geometry and no start/end/year/active-period fields. The documented habitat network is temporally dynamic. Reconstructing the 1993-2017 eligible patch universe would therefore require response-bearing Locality Visit rows, which was prospectively forbidden.
forbidden_repair: do not read Locality Visit rows to infer patch creation/deletion or annual eligibility
do not treat the 2019 latest-geometry patch registry as if it had existed unchanged from 1993 through 2017
do not drop or backfill patches using future response information
do not rerun this endpoint after changing the temporal-universe rule and call it fresh
scientific_interpretation: This candidate is neither evidence for nor evidence against Layer-B predictive complementarity. It failed before any response-bearing annual occupancy data were opened because the historical node universe was not identifiable response-independently.
